xmldoc.short_description: Write lines of text to a file.

param_input_item.param_description: a character vector, a string array or a cell array of character vectors: lines to write. Arrays are written in column order. A missing string is written as an empty line.
a character vector or a string scalar: name of the file to write.

a nonempty character vector or string scalar: text written between the lines. Default: '
' on Windows, '
' on other platforms. Escape sequences 
, , 	,  ,  , \v and \ are interpreted.

a character vector or a string scalar: encoding of the file. Default: 'UTF-8', written without byte order mark. A character that the encoding cannot represent is written as the substitute character (0x1A).
'overwrite' (default) or 'append': replace the file content or add the lines at the end of the file.
'auto' (default), 'always' or 'never': whether a line ending is written after the last line.

description.p: writelines(lines, filename) writes the elements of lines to the file filename, one per line. The text is written as is: line endings inside an element are not converted and escape sequences are not interpreted.

With 'auto', a line ending is added after the last line when this line is not empty and does not already end with LineEnding. A final empty element already ends the text, so no line ending is added after it, except when it is the only element. Without any line, 'auto' and 'always' write a single line ending and 'never' writes nothing.
With WriteMode set to 'append', a missing file is created. When the file is not empty and does not end with LineEnding, a line ending is written first so that the new lines start on a new line.
Names and values of the options are case-insensitive and may be shortened when the prefix is unique.

example_item.example_item_description: Write lines and read them back.
